description: Centerline-Width is the project's Python package for deriving river centre lines and widths from mapped banks. It contains KML and text conversion, Voronoi and smoothed centre-line methods, width calculations and measurements of area or sinuosity. Inputs are left- and right-bank coordinates in CSV; outputs can be exported as CSV or MATLAB files and plotted for inspection. Spatial coverage is the mapped river reach, with resolution determined by the bank points and interpolation choices. Time coverage is that of the source imagery or survey. MIT source is free through GitHub and PyPI. A limitation is beta-quality geometry processing that may require smoothing and intersection removal. Future development is moving to the separately named nyami package. The tool supports river-network preparation for hydraulic and flood-defence simulations. QGIS (platform-qgis) provides related geometry inspection. No bank coordinates were downloaded.
